newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Norvet changes name to Novogen.
newsitem.headline: Norvet changes name to Novogen.

text.p: Australian drug developer Norvet Ltd said it changed its name to Novogen Ltd after shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting on Wednesday.
The company said the new name more accurately reflected its business which was the development of new generations of human pharmaceuticals based on biological processes.
Novogen's expanding intellectual property base had opened up commercial opportunities beyond its initial orientation towards veterinary pharmaceuticals, it said.
The company's Australian Stock Exchange code would remain NRT.AX, it added. -- Sydney newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
